scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.cf:pages:deploy: npm run build -w client && npx wrangler pages deploy client/dist --project-name rya-fruit-client
scripts.cf:workers:deploy: npm run build -w client && node scripts/copy-fruity-images.mjs && npx wrangler deploy --config client/wrangler.toml
scripts.cf:workers:deploy:api: npm run build -w client && npx wrangler deploy --config client/wrangler.toml --var VITE_API_BASE:https://YOUR_API_DOMAIN
